profile_text.body:
Micron Technology Inc. is a public company headquartered in Boise, Idaho, traded under the ticker MU. On its own website, Micron describes itself as a global leader in memory and storage, saying it powers AI and compute-intensive applications from cloud to edge with semiconductor solutions. The site offers data sheets, design tools, technical documentation, a Technology Enablement Program, sales support, and an online source for placing and tracking orders for Micron memory samples. It also states that mobile memory and storage accelerate AI-driven technologies.

The harvested site text contains no named product lines beyond these general descriptions, and no AI-specific products are listed among the company's tracked products. The site's framing of AI is as an application area its memory and storage serve, rather than as a distinct product category.

The held record shows no lawsuits and no MCP servers associated with the company. Its law exposure is recorded in Idaho, with a count of 21.
